Container.Name: Envoryx
Container.Overview:
Envoryx - Docker-native development environments for Unraid.
Manage complete development stacks (PHP, web server, database, cache) per project from a modern web UI. Envoryx creates isolated Docker containers for every project automatically; you never edit compose files.
Projects are stored in the "Projects" share and published on ports 20000-20999 by default. With the proxy ports (80/443) mapped, every project is also reachable as https://<name>.test through Envoryx's embedded reverse proxy and local certificate authority.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the Envoryx web interface.

Config.Name: Proxy HTTP port
Config.Description: Embedded reverse proxy: opens projects by domain (http://shop.test). Change the host port if 80 is taken on your server; Envoryx detects the mapping.

Config.Name: SSH port (IDE remote interpreter)
Config.Description: Embedded SSH server for PhpStorm/VS Code remote interpreters and SFTP into project containers. Optional.

Config.Name: Proxy HTTPS port
Config.Description: Embedded reverse proxy with certificates from Envoryx's local CA (https://shop.test). Change the host port if 443 is taken.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Envoryx database, generated configuration and backups.

Config.Name: Projects
Config.Description: Root folder of all development projects. Each project gets its own sub-folder.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Required: Envoryx creates the project containers through the Docker engine. See SECURITY.md for the socket-proxy alternative.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id project files are owned by (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id project files are owned by (100 = users).

Config.Name: Project port range start
Config.Description: First host port assigned to project web servers.

Config.Name: Project port range end
Config.Description: Last host port assigned to project web servers.

Config.Name: Host for project links (optional)
Config.Description: IP or host name browsers should use to open projects. Set this to the Unraid IP if Envoryx runs with its own IP (br0/macvlan) or behind a reverse proxy. Can also be changed in Envoryx's settings.

Config.Name: Projects host path (optional)
Config.Description: Only needed if auto-detection fails: the host path you mapped to /projects, e.g. /mnt/user/development.

Config.Name: Config host path (optional)
Config.Description: Only needed if auto-detection fails: the host path you mapped to /config, e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/envoryx.

Config.Name: Admin user (optional)
Config.Description: Create the admin account automatically instead of via the setup page. Must be set together with the password.
